landing.faq.stack.question: What's the tech stack?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth. Every piece of business logic is inlined — no external packages for payment, email, storage, or AI.
landing.faq.payment.question: Which payment providers are supported?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Stripe, PayPal, Creem, Alipay, and WeChat Pay out of the box. The PaymentManager abstraction makes it straightforward to add more providers by implementing a single interface.
landing.faq.database.question: Which databases can I use?
landing.faq.database.answer: Drizzle ORM handles PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. Switch providers by editing DATABASE_PROVIDER in your .env — the schema templates and drizzle config adapt automatically.
landing.faq.customize.question: How customizable is the landing page?
landing.faq.customize.answer: The src/blocks/ directory ships with demo sections — they're designed to be rewritten per project. The durable primitives live in src/components/, so your rebrand touches blocks and translations, not the chassis.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
landing.faq.license.answer: Yes. ShipAny Next is built for shipping production SaaS products. You own the code after cloning — no per-seat fees, no runtime dependencies on our infrastructure.
landing.cta.headline: Ready to ship your SaaS?
landing.cta.subheadline: Stop wiring auth, payments, and RBAC from scratch. Start with ShipAny Next and build what actually makes your product unique.

studio.faq_subtitle: Practical answers about prompts, image editing, transparent PNGs and using Prism Studio.
studio.faq.one_a: Qwen Image 2.1 is a unified image generation and editing model released by the Qwen team on September 20, 2026. It supports native transparency and multiple reference images. Prism Studio is an independent interface, not an official Qwen product.
studio.faq.two_q: Can I generate images here right now?
studio.faq.two_a: This version is a studio preview until a model service is connected. You can try prompts, switch modes and upload a reference. The preview artwork is illustrative and is not presented as a Qwen-generated result. When connected, sign in to submit a real generation.
studio.faq.three_q: What makes a transparent PNG different?
studio.faq.three_a: An RGBA image includes an alpha channel, so the background can truly be transparent rather than painted white. In transparent mode, the studio adds the model's recommended transparency instruction to your prompt.
studio.faq.four_q: Can I use this model for commercial work?
studio.faq.four_a: Commercial availability depends on the model license and your service provider's terms. The current Qwen Image 2.1 research license requires separate commercial permission. Confirm suitable authorization before using a connected service for paid or commercial work.

studio.faq.model.a: Qwen Image 2.1 combines text-to-image generation and image editing in one model, with native support for transparent RGBA images. Prism Studio provides an independent interface for exploring these workflows and is not an official Qwen service.
studio.faq.availability.q: Can I generate images here now, and is it free?
studio.faq.availability.a: Image generation requires sign-in and a connected model service. Check the live connection status in the workspace. Browsing prompts and uploading a reference do not start a generation. Paid plans and credit allowances are currently proposed.
studio.faq.reference.q: How many reference images can I upload?
studio.faq.reference.a: This first workspace accepts one PNG, JPG or WebP reference image, up to 5 MB. The model's broader multi-reference capabilities are separate from the controls currently available in this interface.
studio.faq.artwork.q: Are the images shown here Qwen Image 2.1 results?
studio.faq.artwork.a: The carousel and prompt cards use original Prism Studio illustrations created for the website. They demonstrate creative directions, not verified Qwen model output or benchmark performance. Actual connected-service results appear separately after generation.
studio.faq.privacy.q: What happens to an uploaded reference image?
studio.faq.privacy.a: Selecting a reference loads it into the current browser workspace. It is sent to the configured generation service only when you submit a real task. You can remove it before submission. Retention and processing after submission depend on that service's privacy terms.
studio.faq.commercial.q: Can I use Qwen Image 2.1 for commercial projects?
studio.faq.commercial.a: Check the model license and your inference provider's terms before commercial use. The current research license requires separate commercial permission. The studio does not grant rights beyond those provided by the model or service.
studio.faq.home.prompt.q: How do I write a good Qwen Image 2.1 prompt?
studio.faq.home.prompt.a: Start with a clear subject, then add the setting, composition, light, materials and visual style. Keep important constraints explicit, such as no text or preserving a product's shape. Try a prompt card, change one detail at a time, and review the output.
studio.faq.home.modes.q: What is the difference between Generate and Edit image?
studio.faq.home.modes.a: Generate starts from a text description. Edit image uses an uploaded reference plus instructions about changes. Transparent mode adds instructions for an alpha-channel PNG. Choose the mode that matches the starting material and desired result.
studio.faq.home.ratio.q: Which aspect ratios can I choose?
studio.faq.home.ratio.a: The workspace offers 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3 and 3:4. Use square for product cards, landscape for banners and portrait for mobile compositions. The connected provider determines the final pixel dimensions; a ratio selection is not a fixed-resolution guarantee.
studio.faq.transparent.alpha.q: Does a transparent PNG have a real alpha channel?
studio.faq.transparent.alpha.a: A true transparent PNG includes alpha information. A white or checkerboard background painted into the image is not transparency. Inspect the downloaded PNG in an editor or place it over a colored background to check its edges.
studio.faq.transparent.prompt.q: How should I prompt for a transparent background?
studio.faq.transparent.prompt.a: Describe a single subject and its style, then ask for an RGBA image with an alpha channel and transparent background. Transparent mode adds these instructions for you. Avoid asking for a full background scene if you need a reusable cutout.
studio.faq.transparent.uses.q: What can I make with transparent PNGs?
studio.faq.transparent.uses.a: Plan botanical stickers, product cutouts, icons or decorative elements that can be layered into another design. Review the generated edges and partial transparency before exporting. A clear silhouette and simple composition often make an asset easier to reuse.
studio.faq.editor.preserve.q: How can I ask the model to preserve product details?
studio.faq.editor.preserve.a: Use a clear reference and state the properties to preserve, such as silhouette, colors, logos and proportions. Specify only the background or lighting changes you need. Always review the output; a prompt cannot guarantee exact identity or detail preservation.
studio.faq.editor.background.q: Can I change only the background of a photo?
studio.faq.editor.background.a: Choose Edit image, upload a reference and ask to keep the foreground unchanged while replacing the background. Describe the new setting, light direction and contact shadow. This version uses text instructions; it does not yet provide a brush or region mask.
studio.faq.editor.format.q: Which image formats work for editing?
studio.faq.editor.format.a: Upload PNG, JPG or WebP files under 5 MB. Use a sharp, well-lit image where the subject is clearly visible. Very small, compressed or cluttered references can make the desired change harder to describe and evaluate.
studio.faq.prompts.reuse.q: How do I use a prompt from the library?
studio.faq.prompts.reuse.a: Click a prompt card or the front carousel card to copy its description into the workspace. The card also chooses a suitable creation mode. Edit the subject, colors or composition, then check service availability before submitting.
studio.faq.prompts.match.q: Will a prompt recreate its example image exactly?
studio.faq.prompts.match.a: No exact match is promised. The artwork is an original creative illustration, and results vary with the connected model, parameters and random seed. Use the example as a direction for composition and style, then refine your own version.
studio.faq.prompts.languages.q: Can I write prompts in English or Chinese?
studio.faq.prompts.languages.a: The workspace accepts either language and provides English and Chinese starter prompts. Keep key details concrete and consistent instead of repeating synonyms. If a provider rewrites or translates prompts, its handling may affect the final result.

studio.pricing.seo.description: Preview Prism Studio plans for Qwen Image 2.1 image creation. Compare proposed monthly and yearly pricing, credits and creative tools before paid plans launch.
studio.pricing.heading: Find your creative rhythm.
studio.pricing.subtitle: Explore Qwen Image 2.1 creative plans, from your first idea to a busier workflow.
studio.pricing.notice: Prices and credit allowances below are proposed. Paid subscriptions are not available yet.
studio.pricing.free.name: Explorer
studio.pricing.free.copy: A little inspiration goes a long way.
studio.pricing.creator.name: Creator
studio.pricing.creator.copy: For personal projects and fresh ideas.
studio.pricing.pro.name: Pro
studio.pricing.no_payment: No payment is collected on this page.
studio.pricing.compare.title: Every plan, side by side.
studio.pricing.compare.copy: The Explorer tools are available now. Paid-plan features and credit allowances are a preview of the proposed launch offering.
studio.pricing.faq.title: A few things worth knowing.
studio.pricing.faq.pay.a: Not yet. This page previews proposed launch pricing. Checkout is not enabled, and browsing a plan will not create a subscription or charge your card.
studio.pricing.faq.free.q: What can I do on the free plan?
studio.pricing.faq.free.a: Browse 39 original image-and-prompt examples, filter by category, copy full prompts and prepare a creation in the studio. Generation requires sign-in and a connected model service; check the workspace status for availability.
studio.pricing.faq.credit.a: The proposed Creator and Pro plans include monthly credit allowances. The credit cost of a task will be shown before you generate; final costs depend on the model and output settings. The current preview does not spend credits.
studio.pricing.faq.annual.q: How do monthly and yearly prices compare?
studio.pricing.faq.annual.a: Proposed monthly pricing is $12 for Creator and $29 for Pro. Yearly pricing is $108 and $288 respectively, paid upfront, equivalent to $9 and $24 per month. Credit allowances are monthly in either case.
studio.pricing.faq.cancel.q: Where can I manage a subscription?
studio.pricing.faq.cancel.a: When paid plans launch, subscription management will be available in your account. Final renewal, cancellation and refund terms will be displayed before checkout. No subscription is created by the current preview.
studio.pricing.faq.commercial.q: Can I use generated images commercially?
studio.pricing.faq.commercial.a: Commercial use depends on the connected model provider’s terms and the rights to your prompts and references. A paid plan does not replace those permissions. Review the applicable terms before using an image commercially.
studio.pricing.closing.title: Start with an idea worth exploring.
studio.pricing.closing.copy: Find your next direction in the original prompt library.
studio.pricing.dialog.title: Your {plan} launch plan
studio.pricing.dialog.copy: This is a preview of the proposed plan. Subscriptions are not open yet and no payment will be taken.
